items.title: Affirm (NASDAQ:AFRM) Delivers Strong Q2 CY2026 Numbers, Stock Soars
items.summary: Buy now, pay later company Affirm (NASDAQ:AFRM) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 33% year on year to $1.17 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($1.21 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 3.6% above what analysts were expecting. Its GAAP profit of $4.62 per share was significantly above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: PayPal Holdings (PYPL) Tuition Payment Push Puts Its Valuation Narrative Back In Focus
items.summary: PayPal Holdings (PYPL) is back in focus after announcing integrations that let students and families pay tuition with PayPal and Venmo through campus payment platforms such as Nelnet Campus Commerce, Illumia, and TouchNet. These tuition integrations arrive at a time when PayPal Holdings’ share price has climbed 10.24% over the past month and 39.02% over the past 90 days, while the 1 year total shareholder return is still down 10.49%, which signals recent momentum from a depressed base.
